section: Where to buy and sell things
title: Facebook groups
text: If you want to trade with English-speaking Berliners, try Sell Your Stuff Berlin or Free Your Stuff Berlin. You must be approved before you can join those groups. Sell Your Stuff Berlin – 85 000+ members Free/Sell/Buy your stuff Berlin – 30 000+ members Sell your furniture Berlin – 21 000+ members Girls Sell Stuff Berlin – 11 000+ members
